description: The data model as a Mermaid `erDiagram`, read from the schemas: content-types (optionally components) with their fields, one line per association with its cardinalities, media and the plugin types they link to. For a README, a doc or an issue.

allPlugins.description: Every installed plugin type, not only those linked to (default false).

focus.description: Only these UIDs and the types they link to.

from.description: A path inside the project (the file you are editing; relative to its root with `project`), in a multi-project workspace.

hideCustomFields.description: Leave out custom fields: true for all, or their names (listed under `customFields` in the answer). Default: none.

media.description: Media fields → the upload plugin's File (default true).

project.description: A project name or root, when no path is at hand.

strapiFields.description: The fields Strapi adds: createdAt, updatedAt, publishedAt, createdBy/updatedBy (default false).

name: get_model_diagram
title: Data model diagram (Mermaid)
